description: SynthOscillator (vital/src/synthesis/producers/synth_oscillator.cpp) on rendered wavetables. Wavetables are init, predefined and well-conditioned creator content only (no frequency-domain keyframe interpolation between disjoint spectra, no Phase Shift component). Ported in port/crates/oscillators. Covers integer MIDI notes, phase, level/pan, wave-frame selection (A1b), unison voices/detune/stack styles/blend/spread, random phase (A2), every distortion type (FM/RM read the 'modulation' input), single-voice processing, reset offsets, retrigger, sample rates, oversampling and block sizes, constant and audio-rate transpose and tune, transpose snapping (local and global) and a swept note. Pitch is also compared in synth_oscillator_pitch.json. Cases with "reference": "nofastmath" (listed in migration/decisions/nofastmath/oscillators/synth_oscillator.md, SAS-35) are compared bit for bit against the no-fast-math reference of each target. Cases named interim_* are well-conditioned stand-ins kept from before the re-enable.
